findings.keyring_mode: keyring-only; no file fallback; successful keyring save removes auth.json
findings.keyring_identity: credential entry is scoped by canonical CODEX_HOME
findings.default_child_environment: inherits all parent variables unless overridden
findings.representative_child_environment: inherit=core excludes OPENAI_API_KEY while retaining PATH/HOME
findings.exec_approval_policy: codex exec hard-defaults AskForApproval::Never in headless mode
findings.exec_approval_requests: exec mode does not support command/file/patch/permissions approval requests
findings.sandbox_orchestration: shell/unified-exec and apply_patch route through shared sandbox policy/orchestrator
findings.subagents: spawned agents clone effective parent config and live approval/sandbox policy
findings.code_mode: V8 runtime exposes only controlled globals/tools and rejects unsupported module imports; representative campaign disables code_mode
findings.external_surface: representative campaign disables multi-agent and account/network-backed app/plugin/browser/computer/image/skill-search features

limitations: source review does not prove runtime host isolation
source review does not authenticate a qualification receipt
future executable or source drift requires a new review
